description: This file defines ASN.1 E1AP protocol message structures, including message types, procedures, and containers for 3GPP TS ASN1 E1AP v18.5.0 (2025-06). It includes class and struct definitions for E1AP messages, procedures, and related data containers, with functions for packing, unpacking, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: e1ap::init_msg_s
classes.description: Represents the initial E1AP message with procedure code, criticality, and message content.

classes.name: e1ap::successful_outcome_s
classes.description: Represents a successful response message with procedure code, criticality, and message content.

classes.name: e1ap::unsuccessful_outcome_s
classes.description: Represents an unsuccessful response message with procedure code, criticality, and message content.

classes.name: e1ap::e1ap_pdu_c
classes.description: Represents the top-level E1AP Protocol Data Unit (PDU) as a choice among different message types.

classes.name: e1ap::e1ap_elem_procs_o
classes.description: Contains definitions for various E1AP elementary procedures, including initiation, success, and failure messages.

methods.name: set()
methods.description: Sets the message type for the procedure or response.

methods.name: pack()
methods.description: Serializes the message into a bit buffer.

methods.name: unpack()
methods.description: Deserializes the message from a bit buffer.

methods.name: to_json()
methods.description: Serializes the message to JSON format.

methods.name: load_info_obj()
methods.description: Loads message info from a procedure code.
